items.name: KIVIK Sofa - Gunnared beige
items.why: Beige KIVIK sofa is a calm, neutral anchor that suits cream walls and light wood. At 2.28 m it fits the 3.97 m short side with room to walk around it.

items.name: UGGLERUM Coffee table - walnut veneer 51 1/8x25 5/8 "
items.why: UGGLERUM walnut-veneer table adds warm wood tone in a modest 1.3 m length, in proportion with the sofa and within budget.

items.name: STOCKHOLM 2025 TV unit with sliding doors - oak veneer 70 3/8x16 1/2x22 1/8 "
items.why: STOCKHOLM 2025 TV unit in oak veneer with sliding doors matches the light-wood direction and gives closed storage for a clean, modern look.

items.name: POÄNG Armchair - birch veneer/Knisa light beige
items.why: PÄNG armchair in birch veneer with light beige upholstery is airy and calm, and its birch frame echoes the oak and wood tones.

items.name: KALLAX Shelf unit - white 30 1/8x57 5/8 "
items.why: White KALLAX shelf unit is a simple, light modern bookcase that keeps the wall visually open and works with the wood tones.

items.name: RANARP Floor/reading lamp - black
items.why: Black RANARP floor lamp adds a crisp contrast accent to the light palette and gives adequate reading light beside the armchair.
